messages:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] HIGH: routing error spike -> fallback to incompatible variant detected for customer AcmeCorp (gen requests returning chat/instruct responses). Alert ID: INC-2026-1767. Logs: https://redwood/logs/1767012345
maya: I'm oncall, joining now. Paging sam and nguyen for routing/runtime.
sam: oncall here - seeing 5xx and schema mismatches in the logs. Throwing to oncall channel. :phone:
nguyen: digging. Early hypothesis: a version pin for alias `acme-embedding` was set to a version that only supports chat/instruct interface. Fallback policy then routed to that variant for embeddings, causing type mismatches and 500s.
olivia: customer-impact: AcmeCorp realtime ingestion 2.3X error rate, 18% of tokens failing; BetaApp a few calls. We should notify CS and decide rollback.
dave: I'm contacting AcmeCorp support channel now to say we're investigating. No PII exposed in logs but outputs are invalid.
nguyen: found the config diff that shipped ~20m ago:
```
fallback_policy:
  - when: interface_mismatch
    fallback_to: pinned_variant
```
and the alias pin:
```
alias: acme-embedding
pinned_version: v2026-03-01-instruct-only
```
that pinned variant doesn't expose embedding API.
maya: immediate mitigation options?
sam: options:
- remove the pin from alias (fast)
- change fallback_policy to reject or route to nearest compatible model
- temporary routing override for AcmeCorp to a known-good embeddings instance
nguyen: I can unpin now. Command:
```
redwoodctl alias unpin --alias acme-embedding --reason "emergency rollback - incompatible variant"
```
running now...
nguyen: done. unpin returned 0 and alias now resolves to acme-embedding@latest-compatible
incidents-bot: Metric: embeddings 5xxs for AcmeCorp dropped from 18% -> 1.5% in 90s. Latency stable. :white_check_mark:
olivia: notify AcmeCorp that we unpinned and are monitoring. dave you handle comms please.
dave: messaged them - they acknowledged and asked for RCA.
tess: note: BetaApp saw minor impact, will reach out if they escalate.
maya: good. next actions: (1) owner (nguyen) to backfill test to ensure alias pin rejection for interface mismatches, (2) product to add guardrail in rollout UI to warn when pinning incompatible variants (olivia), (3) runbook update to include immediate `redwoodctl` unpin steps (sam).
nguyen: filing a post-incident ticket and will attach repro and config diffs.
olivia: scheduling a follow-up in 2hrs to review mitigation and customer comms. thanks team. :pray:
